triggers.detailsText: The CIRP of the Company was initiated by the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench (“NCLT”) vide its order dated 16th December, 2022 (“Admission Order”), pursuant to which Mr Ashwin Bhavanji Shah was appointed as the Interim Resolution Professional (“IRP”). Subsequently, pursuant to the order passed by the Hon’ble NCLT, Mumbai Bench, on an application filed by Prudent ARC, Mr Arihant Nenawati was appointed as the Resolution Professional (“RP”) of the Company with effect from 22nd January, 2024. Mr Vipin Choudhary has affirmed that he is not debarred from holding the office of Director by virtue of any SEBI order or any other authority and the same has been taken on record by the Board (Brief Profile Attached as Annexure I).
filingKeyFacts: The CIRP of the Company was initiated by the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench (“NCLT”) vide its order dated 16th December, 2022 (“Admission Order”), pursuant to which Mr Ashwin Bhavanji Shah was appointed as the Interim Resolution Professional (“IRP”).

Subsequently, pursuant to the order passed by the Hon’ble NCLT, Mumbai Bench, on an application filed by Prudent ARC, Mr Arihant Nenawati was appointed as the Resolution Professional (“RP”) of the Company with effect from 22nd January, 2024.

Mr Vipin Choudhary has affirmed that he is not debarred from holding the office of Director by virtue of any SEBI order or any other authority and the same has been taken on record by the Board (Brief Profile Attached as Annexure I).
